name: polyseek
description: Executive-search candidate searches in ChatGPT with polyseek: brief the mandate, review and confirm the search plan, run the search, read the ranked and verified candidates, refine them in a second pass and get verified business contacts. German and English. Beta with exclusive early access.

interface.longDescription:
polyseek gives executive-search consultants their research team inside ChatGPT. Describe a mandate, review and confirm the search plan, and polyseek delivers a ranked, verified candidate list with sources and export. Refine a search in a second pass, get verified business contact details for chosen candidates, profile companies and people, identify the employer behind an anonymous job posting, and find earlier work. English and German.

Requirements: polyseek is in beta with exclusive early access for executive-search firms. Connect with your personal polyseek access code; firms without one request access on the sign-in screen. Nothing is sold inside ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Plan a candidate search for this job description and show me the plan
Profile this company for a pitch: strategy, leadership team, hiring signals
Which searches have I run with polyseek?
